problem_plain: CBA needed to replace its legacy core banking system to support continued growth and modernisation rather than extend existing infrastructure.
capability: Cloud-based core banking platform built on SAP Transaction Banking (TRBK) on AWS with controlled incremental cutover, built-in automation, rapid-recovery safeguards, and event streaming for real-time visibility.
scale_outcomes: 70M+ daily transactions; ~30% faster performance; ~30% lower daily run costs
reusable: Controlled incremental change methodology as alternative to big-bang cutover; built-in automation and rapid-recovery safeguards; event streaming architecture for real-time visibility; end-to-end service ownership model.
summary: CBA replaced its legacy core banking system with a cloud-based SAP Transaction Banking platform on AWS, supporting approximately 40% of Australia's payments. The delivery achieved minimal customer disruption at 70M+ daily transactions whilst delivering ~30% faster performance and ~30% lower daily run costs through controlled incremental change and real-time visibility.
